_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_ROLLING group overlay that emits a per-point windowed z-score against the rolling-window mean + SAMPLE SD of the W=3 immediately preceding points (zscore_i = (point - rolling_mean) / rolling_sd, sd via Welford triple with n-1 denominator). Windowed-Process kind sharing the carrier shape with OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_ROLLING_MEAN (28_process_index_vs_rolling_mean.json) — both maintain a per-group ring buffer of the W most recent PRESENT values plus the Welford (count, mean, M2) trio updated alongside each push / evict. Buffered (the ring buffer carrier widens past v1's single-state lag accumulator). Window-fill semantics: fewer than 2 prior PRESENT points emits NaN without warning. Zero rolling-SD emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0.
_meta.name: process-zscore-vs-rolling
